steps_h2: How to Make a Product Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Pick a guide, use your own product, and download the photo or video you need for your next post.

steps.d: Take a clear photo of the product you sell, then choose the guide for your next photo or ad.
Follow the guide to upload your photo or paste your product link. Review the result before you spend credits again.
Download your finished image or video and post it where its size fits.

faq.q: Can I reuse one product photo in several guides?
faq.a: Yes. Use the same photo to try different product images and video ads. Each new file uses credits.

faq.q: Do I need video editing experience?
faq.a: No. Follow the steps with one clear product photo and a short message. You can make an ad without editing software.

faq.q: Where can I post the result?
faq.a: Post the result on your store, social feed, or in a paid ad. Pick a size that fits the placement.

faq.q: How many credits do photos and videos use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits; 6, 10, 15, and 30 second videos use 24, 40, 60, and 120. Failed jobs return credits.

faq.q: What can I learn from these product guides?
faq.a: These guides show you how to make product photos and video ads, choose sizes, and test different versions. Start with the task you need today.
A guide gives you clear steps for making an ad from your product photo. It helps you start quickly and check the result.

faq.q: Can I make an ad without booking a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a product photo to make a new image or creator-style video. You do not need a film crew.

faq.q: Will these guides work for my kind of store?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a guide that fits your product and where you plan to post it. Use its steps to make your own ad.
Sellers making their own product photos and ads, and small teams that need clear steps for the next campaign.

faq.q: Can I use my download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use your watermark-free download in ads or on your store, and check each platform’s rules before posting.

faq.q: How do I use a guide to make an ad?
faq.a: Choose the guide for your task and follow its steps with your own product photo or link. You can make the result in minutes.

faq.q: Which guide helps me make a video with a presenter?
faq.a: Start with the first TikTok video ad guide, then choose an AI actor for your product. You can make it without hiring a presenter.
